description: F23 §E.4: outcome.v2's integer-string, unitless money fields cannot encode the golden (0.2, -0.1, net 5.1). outcome.v3 is the additive major in which every money field is an exact reduced rational {num: int64-string, den: int64-string} with a declared quote unit and mandatory fee-conversion mark preimages. LAWS BOUND WITH THIS SCHEMA (enforced by the E10 owner's semantic validator beside shape validation; JSON Schema alone cannot express them all): (1) CONSERVATION — quantity conservation sum(entry_qty_steps) == sum(exit_qty_steps) is required for status COMPLETE; a non-conserved outcome may never be COMPLETE. (2) TERMINAL — COMPLETE is terminal; a terminal outcome's money fields are frozen; the emergency cohort is permanently separate and never pools with the non-emergency cohort. (3) NULL — R_net is NULL when initial risk is unknown or <= 0; markout_bps(h) is NULL when the causal mid mark at horizon h is unavailable; a NULL is an honest absence, never a fabricated zero. (4) IDENTITY — SHADOW/PAPER/TESTNET/LIVE execution identity is mandatory and never mixed. GOLDEN: gross 6 - fees 1 + rebates 0.2 + funding (-0.1) = 5.1 encodes as {"num":"51","den":"10"}.

schema_version.description: DRAFT discriminator. The E10 owner's published major replaces this with the published version string at publication; no reader may treat a *-DRAFT record as effective.

outcome_id.description: Immutable outcome identity assigned by the E10 owner service.

campaign_ref.description: Optional reference to the owning campaign/subject record (E10 owner's identity law).

instrument_id.description: Optional instrument identity per the estate contract catalog.

execution_identity.description: IDENTITY LAW (§E.4): mandatory and never mixed. An aggregation that pools two identities is invalid at the semantic validator; this field never defaults.

emergency_cohort.description: EMERGENCY COHORT LAW (§E.4): the emergency cohort is permanently separate. true rows never pool with false rows in any downstream read, learning, or attribution surface.

order_side_sign.description: Signed side convention entering fill_cost_bps and markout_bps: +1 buy/long, -1 sell/short.

quote_unit.description: Declared quote unit for EVERY money field in this record (e.g. USDT). A money field without this declared unit is meaningless; unit conversion preimages live in fee_conversion_marks.

gross_pnl.description: Gross PnL in quote_unit. Golden component: 6.

fees.description: Total fees in quote_unit (signed convention: fees reduce net). Golden component: 1.

rebates.description: Total rebates in quote_unit. Golden component: 2/10.

funding.description: SIGNED funding in quote_unit (§E.4 signed-funding law). Golden component: -1/10.

net.description: Net = gross_pnl - fees + rebates + funding, computed in exact rational arithmetic — never floating point. GOLDEN: gross 6 - fees 1 + rebates 0.2 + funding (-0.1) = 5.1 encodes exactly as {"num":"51","den":"10"}.

initial_risk_quote.description: Initial risk in quote_unit at decision time; null when unknown. NULL LAW: when null or <= 0, r_net MUST be null.

r_net.description: R_net = net / initial_risk_quote. NULL LAW (§E.4): NULL when initial risk is unknown or <= 0 — never a fabricated zero, never a division by an invented risk.

fill_cost_bps.description: fill_cost_bps = order_side_sign x (fill - decision_ref)/decision_ref x 10^4, exact rational; null when the decision reference is unavailable (honest absence).

^h[0-9]+(ms|s|m)$.description: markout_bps(h) = order_side_sign x (mid_{t+h} - fill)/fill x 10^4. NULL LAW (§E.4): NULL when the causal mid mark at horizon h is unavailable — a missing mark is never interpolated or fabricated.

markout_bps.description: Per-horizon markouts keyed by horizon token (e.g. h1s, h5m). Every value is an exact rational or null under the causal-mark null law.

fee_conversion_marks.description: MANDATORY fee-conversion mark preimages (§E.4): every conversion of a fee/rebate/funding amount from its native asset into quote_unit records the exact mark used, its source, and its time — the preimage that makes the converted money field reproducible. Empty ONLY when every money component was natively denominated in quote_unit (no conversion occurred).

mark_source.description: Named mark source (venue mark/index identity); never an unnamed number.

mark_time.description: Causal mark timestamp (must not postdate the conversion it prices).

entry_qty_steps_sum.description: Sum of entry quantity steps (exact integer string).

exit_qty_steps_sum.description: Sum of exit quantity steps (exact integer string).

quantity_conservation.description: CONSERVATION LAW (§E.4): sum(entry_qty_steps) == sum(exit_qty_steps) is REQUIRED for status COMPLETE. The equality is enforced by the E10 semantic validator; a non-conserved record presenting status COMPLETE is invalid.

status.description: TERMINAL LAW: COMPLETE is terminal and requires quantity conservation; QUARANTINED marks a record failing a semantic law (never silently dropped, never silently completed). Enum finalization is the E10 owner's publication decision.

int64_string.description: Signed integer as a decimal string. Range law (semantic validator): must fit int64 [-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807]; the pattern bounds digit count, the validator bounds the value. Never a JSON number — floating point never touches a money field.

uint_string.description: Unsigned integer as a decimal string; int64 range enforced by the semantic validator.

den.description: Strictly positive denominator as a decimal string (int64 range); zero and negative denominators are unrepresentable.

exact_rational.description: EXACT REDUCED RATIONAL (§E.4): value = num/den with gcd(|num|, den) == 1 and den > 0. Reducedness is a semantic law (JSON Schema cannot express gcd); the E10 validator rejects an unreduced pair. The sign lives on num. GOLDEN: 5.1 => {"num":"51","den":"10"}.
